title: Design System: Your Office Partners Business Card

colorAlphas.name: ghost-edge
colorAlphas.purpose: Ghost pill hairline and list-label rule; 0.22 on hover.

colorAlphas.name: plum-glow
colorAlphas.purpose: Single radial glow at the top of the dark screen: radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%, ..., transparent 70%).

colorAlphas.name: active-tile
colorAlphas.purpose: Icon tile during the channel sweep.

colorAlphas.name: active-text
colorAlphas.purpose: Row detail and arrow during the channel sweep.

headline.purpose: Company headline on paper, in pressed plum.

body-sm.purpose: Contact row details, tabular numerals, ellipsis.

label-list.purpose: Contact list label with trailing hairline.

motion.name: channel-sweep
motion.purpose: Channel colour fill on row hover, focus, press.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: translateY(10px) + blur(4px) to rest over 0.9s, 60ms stagger from 80ms

motion.name: resolve
motion.value: translateY(20px) + blur(3px), view() timeline entry 10% to cover 30%
motion.purpose: Paper screen on scroll where supported.

motion.name: tick-wave
motion.value: scroll-driven smoothstep crest, 0.25s linear per tick
motion.purpose: Ruler ticks lift as the page scrolls.

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: Save contact. The single bone-filled action on the dark screen.
components.html: Save contact
components.css: .ds-stage { background: var(--ink); padding: 24px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 650; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.5s var(--ease-out), background-color 0.3s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.5s var(--ease-out), color 0.3s var(--ease-out); } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 0.12s; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0c9dd; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pill svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-pill-primary { background: var(--bone); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -10px rgba(246, 240, 243, 0.35); } .ds-pill-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -12px rgba(246, 240, 243, 0.45); }

components.name: Contact Row
components.description: Signature slab: icon tile, label, detail, arrow; the channel colour sweeps in from the left on hover, focus, press.
components.html: Emailsaleem@yourofficepartners.com
components.css: .ds-stage { background: var(--ink); padding: 24px; } .ds-channel { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 76px; padding: 12px 18px 12px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-slab); background: var(--slab); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--slab-edge); color: var(--bone); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-channel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--fill); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 0.55s var(--ease-out); } .ds-channel-icon { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--tile); transition: background-color 0.4s var(--ease-out); } .ds-channel-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-channel-text { display: grid; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-channel-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-channel-detail { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--bone-soft); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: color 0.4s var(--ease-out); } .ds-channel-go { flex: none; display: inline-flex; color: var(--bone-faint); transition: transform 0.45s var(--ease-out), color 0.3s var(--ease-out); } .ds-channel:hover::before, .ds-channel:focus-visible::before, .ds-channel:active::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-channel:hover .ds-channel-icon, .ds-channel:focus-visible .ds-channel-icon { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); } .ds-channel:hover .ds-channel-detail, .ds-channel:hover .ds-channel-go, .ds-channel:focus-visible .ds-channel-detail, .ds-channel:focus-visible .ds-channel-go { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); } .ds-channel:hover .ds-channel-go { transform: translate(2px, -2px); } .ds-channel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0c9dd; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: List Label
components.description: Names the contact list; expanded tracked caps with a hairline to the column edge. Not a heading kicker.
components.css: .ds-stage { background: var(--ink); padding: 24px; } .ds-list-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 110%; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone-faint); } .ds-list-label::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: rgba(255, 236, 246, 0.12); }

components.name: Ledger Ruler
components.description: The seam between screens: 1px ticks every 12px, every fifth plum; a wave lifts them with scroll.
components.css: .ds-ruler { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; height: 44px; padding: 0 2px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper); } .ds-tick { --lift: 0; flex: none; width: 1px; height: 100%; background: #b7a2b0; transform-origin: top; transform: scaleY(calc(0.3 + var(--lift) * 0.55)); } .ds-tick-major { background: var(--plum); opacity: 0.55; transform: scaleY(calc(0.55 + var(--lift) * 0.45)); }

narrative.overview:
The phone becomes a dark business card in the company's own plum. One narrow centered column, bone-white type on a near-black aubergine ground, a single bone-filled pill that means "save me", and three contact slabs that flood with their channel's colour when touched. A ruler of ledger ticks is the seam into a second, lighter world: cool off-white paper where plum takes over as the action colour and the logo appears in full.

The system is deliberately small and dense in the way a physical card is dense: nothing decorative, every element tappable or identifying. Depth is soft and tonal on the dark screen, soft and lifted on the paper screen. Motion is quiet on arrival (a blur-rise, once) and expressive only in response to the visitor: the fill sweep, the check-mark draw, the tick wave that travels with scroll.

The world is a translation of a user-supplied reference card into Your Office Partners material, so its grammar (dark top, centered name, pills, colour-sweep rows, ruler divider, light company screen) is binding, and its colour and mark are YOP's.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: aubergine ink above the ruler, cool paper below it.
One typeface (Archivo variable) doing everything through weight and width, from 800 condensed display to 700 expanded tracked caps.
Pills for actions, 18px slabs for contact rows, square-ish icon tiles inside the slabs.
Brand plum is the owner colour; channel colours appear only as interaction fills.
The ruler is the only divider between the screens.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Ink above the ruler, paper below it. No third ground, no gradients beyond the single plum glow at the top of the dark screen.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Third-party channel colours exist only as momentary fills behind their own row. At rest every row is plum-family slab.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's weight and width axes. Do not introduce a second typeface.

rules.name: The Tight Top, Tracked Bottom Rule
rules.body: Large type is negatively tracked and condensed; small caps are positively tracked and expanded. Never track display type open.

rules.name: The Soft Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse, offset downward only, with negative spread. No hard offset shadows, no borders heavier than a 1px inset hairline.

dos: Do keep exactly one bone-filled primary pill on the dark screen and one plum pill on paper.
Do build hierarchy from Archivo's weight and width axes (800 at 94% width for display, 700 at 108 to 110% width for tracked caps).
Do use the three radii only: 999px pills, 18px slabs, 14px tiles.
Do let channel colours appear only as the sweep fill behind their own row, from the left, on hover, focus and press.
Do keep the top of the ruler visible at the fold as the scroll cue.
Do gate hover effects behind `(hover: hover)` and honour reduced motion by removing animation, not just shortening it.
donts: Don't add a third ground colour or a section between the dark card and the paper page; the ruler is the only seam.
Don't introduce a second typeface or track display type open.
Don't use hard offset shadows or borders heavier than a 1px inset hairline.
Don't place small tracked caps above headlines as kickers; tracked caps are reserved for the company lockup and the contact list label.
Don't show channel brand colours at rest.
